body: Fixed in bc63a944c. compactSummary now normalizes the input through isObject before property access, so null and non-object layer summaries compact to zero/default breakdowns instead of throwing.

Fixed in bc63a944c. The focused closeout test now asserts the exact validator check ID list, verifies strict byte-order emission, and checks every validator check passes. I also added a malformed-summary regression test for the defensive compaction path.
